invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of performClusteringWithRecordList, and this method likely returns a non-null List.
Method dereferences clusteringGroup by calling clusteringGroup.getSlices(), so it must not be null.
strategyParams is used as an input parameter, passed to performClusteringWithRecordList, and should be non-null.
instantTime is used as a parameter and passed to called methods, so it should not be null.
performClusteringWithRecordList is documented to return at most numOutputGroups WriteStatus; numOutputGroups is clusteringGroup.getNumOutputFileGroups().
